questions.question: Microsoft 365 is an example of which cloud service type?

options.why: IaaS provides VMs and infrastructure, not finished applications.
PaaS is a platform for running your own apps.
Correct. Microsoft 365 is complete software delivered over the internet.
Private cloud is a deployment model, not a service type.

questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 is software as a service: users sign in and use it; Microsoft runs everything else.

questions.question: Which cloud service type requires the least management effort from the customer?

options.why: Correct. The provider manages almost the entire stack.
PaaS still requires you to manage your application.
IaaS requires the most customer management.
On-premises requires you to manage everything.

questions.explanation: Management effort decreases from IaaS to PaaS to SaaS.

questions.question: In a SaaS solution, which TWO remain the customer's responsibility?

options.why: The SaaS provider updates the application.

options.text: The data stored in the service
options.why: Correct. Your information and data are always yours.

questions.explanation: Data, devices, and accounts and identities are always customer responsibilities, even in SaaS.

questions.scenario: A small company wants email and video meetings for all staff by next week. It has no IT team.
questions.question: Which approach is most appropriate?

options.text: Deploy mail servers on Azure VMs
options.why: That is IaaS and requires administration skills.

options.text: Build a custom email app on App Service
options.why: Building email is unnecessary and slow.

options.text: Subscribe to a SaaS productivity suite
options.why: Correct. Ready immediately with no infrastructure to manage.
On-premises requires hardware and skills they do not have.

questions.explanation: Standard business needs with no IT staff are an ideal SaaS use case.
